{{Top|leg}}
The '''Space Monkeys''' was a band that performed during the waning years of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]].

==Organization==
The Monkeys had a high turnover of band personnel, but all members of it were expert musicians. By about [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]], the line-up consisted of a tall, green-colored [[Gender/Legends|female]], who played a wind instrument; a [[Sullustan/Legends|Sullustan]] drummer, a keyboard player who resembled a small, pink elephant; and a [[Human/Legends|Human]] female vocalist. The band prided itself on the range of its repertoire and if someone requested a song that the band didn't know, they would research and learn it.

==History==
The Monkeys were the resident band of the [[Space Monkey Café]], a bar that was located in the [[platform city]] of [[Bayonard]], on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Cularin/Legends|Cularin]]. When the [[heroes of Cularin]] visited the bar in about 32 BBY, the band were playing the song "[[Summertime]]."
